environment.description: Same Express application deployed on EC2 in AWS Organization OU 'ou-prod-svcportal'. The OU has an SCP (Service Control Policy) 'scp-iam-guardrails-v3' attached which contains a Deny statement with Condition key 'aws:RequestedRegion' NOT matching and actions ['iam:AttachUserPolicy', 'iam:CreateUser', 'iam:PutUserPolicy', 'iam:CreateAccessKey'] UNLESS the request includes a condition 'iam:PermissionsBoundary' equal to 'arn:aws:iam::*:policy/ServiceAccountBoundary'. The 'ServiceAccountBoundary' policy itself denies sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, and organizations:* - meaning even if a user is created via CSRF, the created user cannot perform any privileged actions. Additionally, the instance role 'AdminPortalRole' has a permission boundary 'PortalOperatorBoundary' that includes an explicit Deny on iam:AttachUserPolicy when the policy ARN contains 'AdministratorAccess' or 'PowerUser' (StringLike condition on iam:PolicyArn). The SCP evaluation occurs before IAM policy evaluation in the authorization chain.

config.role_boundary_denies: iam:AttachUserPolicy when iam:PolicyArn contains AdministratorAccess or PowerUser
